author: PopBase
text:
Lucy Hale says she has “heard rumours” of a ‘Pretty Little Liars’ original cast reboot:

“We’ll see, I would love to. I feel like I’m at a point now where I’d absolutely be so down, I think everyone else would be as well”

(via ‘On Purpose with Jay Shetty’)
